title: 'Ramen Akeneko 2nd Season' Announces New Staff
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Angyaman 's Ramen Akaneko ( Red Cat Ramen ) revealed new staff and key visual (pictured) for the upcoming second season . The anime is scheduled to premiere in January 2027 on Tokyo TV.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Black Clover Season 2 Episode 6 Previews Noelle and Charlotte Facing Vanica
content: Black Clover Season 2 has released preview images and synopsis for Episode 6 (Episode 176 overall) ahead of its November 7 premiere. The new season officially began on October 3, 2026 , with Crunchyroll streaming it worldwide. The anime previously revealed a special Devil Union Asta visual following Episode 3.
author: Anime Corner

title: This Cult Sci-fi Movie Was Roasted by Critics 38 Years Ago, But It Changed Movies, Video Games, and Art Forever
content: There are definitely movies that age badly. And there are films that look even better decades later. Then there’s the rare one that defies all expectations. Imagine a futuristic city filled with neon lights, motorcycle gangs, and enough government corruption to make everybody suspicious.
author: ComicBook
